last_result.headline: Q20 done, no submission. Found and FIXED a compounding prompt-bloat defect: the runner's live-status ran `ps -eo ...,cmd` untruncated and an autopilot Claude carries its ENTIRE prompt on its command line, so each round embedded the previous round's prompt recursively -- prompt_chars went 15,949 -> 49,212 in one round. `cut -c1-200` saves a measured 32,567 bytes PER ROUND. Consolidated Q10-Q19: ten rounds, ONE submission; every other round closed on evidence. Queue rebuilt 16 -> 5 active with zero new prompts; 11 deferred with reasons; q32 merged into q22; q29/q35 are deadline-critical and q33 now owns re-queueing them.
